sections.title: New Features
items: Saved custom banner and menu-icon templates, with editable artwork/text placement.
Recognition of the 21 known UWUVCI template layouts for user-supplied imports.
Advanced Wii game-file export, extraction management, and revision-checked executable patch tools.
Linux downloads use .tar.gz instead of ZIP, preserving executable permissions.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Clearer build/download activity and more consistent Simple/Advanced controls.
Improved artwork previews, bundled fonts, text-fit checks, and draft handling.
Better light-theme contrast and more consistent button alignment.
Easier access to separate runtime and optional Wii U companion downloads.
Clearer base-download diagnostics and GameCube SD-card troubleshooting.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed Wii extraction/rebuilding for internal filenames that are not portable to Windows.
Fixed the Linux executable name being mistaken for a .desktop shortcut.
Fixed imported-template text and menu-icon layout handling.
Fixed a Simple/Advanced switching crash involving Wii disc-preparation selection.
Corrected passthrough defaults for patched retail Wii executables.
Fixed GameCube autobooter validation of malformed controller-count values in Nintendont configs.
Improved storage cleanup, retry behavior, and preservation of existing runtime settings.

sections.title: New Features
items: Named artwork sets can be saved, reused, renamed, and removed.
Import your own templates and adjust image placement in original VC-style layouts.
Convert compatible 16-bit PCM WAV boot sounds, with preview of the converted six-second output.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Clearer artwork choices, frame previews, base-download checks, and retry feedback.
Improved removable-drive detection and Linux diagnostics.
Advanced Wii options include clearer compatibility guidance and a reset to recommended wrapper settings.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed first-run data-folder handling on Bazzite and other immutable Linux systems.
Fixed console payload paths that could work on Windows but fail on Linux.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed base-download validation incorrectly rejecting valid Title ID and Title Key combinations.
Replaced affected macOS downloads with newly signed and notarized packages that retain required symbolic links and executable permissions.

sections.title: New Features
items: Native macOS downloads join Windows and Linux.
Separate Windows ARM64 and Linux ARM64 preview downloads are available.

sections.title: Improvements
items: The first-use guide adds Back, Next, page numbers, and Skip.
New profiles enable Guided Tips by default while preserving existing preferences.
Custom WAV and BTSND boot sounds can be selected, previewed, or cleared from either mode.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Wii runtime options refresh correctly when switching Simple and Advanced modes.
Automatic SD copying works for single builds as well as batches.
Valid macOS and Linux data folders are no longer incorrectly rejected as filesystem roots.

sections.title: New Features
items: The initial Windows and Linux release brings game preparation, artwork, runtime settings, building, and transfer tools into one workflow.
Simple and Advanced modes organize the Base/Runtime, Game, Artwork, and Build steps.
Supported compressed inputs, split Wii WBFS handling, batch builds, storage controls, and support bundles help prepare and troubleshoot owned game backups.
